## Description {#details}

Deprecated generic strongly-typed wrapper for explicit type conversion.

The <code><Link to="/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/-t">&#95;t</Link></code> template provides a public, strongly-typed wrapper for any type <code>T</code>, enabling explicit conversion of dynamic values and expressions to a type recognised by the µTest++ comparators and reporting mechanisms.

This wrapper inherits from <code><Link to="/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/type-traits/value">type&#95;traits::value</Link>&lt;T&gt;</code>, ensuring that the encapsulated value is treated as the specified type within the framework.


<XrefSect
  title="Deprecated"
  permalink="/docs/api/pages/deprecated/#_deprecated000024">
Use <code><Link to="/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/to-t">to&#95;t</Link></code> (since 3.2.0).
</XrefSect>
